content: मृ €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> (but <ab>P.</ab> in the Perfect, the two Futures and the Conditional) (म्रियते, ममार, अमृत, मरिष्यति, मर्तुम्, मृत) To die, perish, decease, depart from life. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (मारयति-ते) To kill, slay. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (मुमूर्षति) .²1 To wish to die. .²2 To be about to die, be on the point of death.
